title: TAT-3131 + TAT-3272 — Add Funds deposit opens and one back tap returns to market detail
description: End-to-end proof of the original bug: from the Perps order-entry screen, tapping the Available-to-trade Add Funds (+) icon opens the deposit confirmation (TAT-3272: the Arbitrum network is added automatically), and after returning from the deposit screen a SINGLE tap of the order-entry back button returns to the Perps market detail screen (TAT-3131: no phantom history entry, no double-tap). Reverting either fix makes this recipe FAIL: revert TAT-3272 and the deposit never opens (ac1-wait-deposit times out); revert TAT-3131 and one back tap lands on the phantom confirmation instead of market detail (ac1-wait-market-detail times out).

pre_conditions.account: any unlocked fixture account on a Perps-enabled wallet
pre_conditions.network: Arbitrum may be absent; TAT-3272 adds it on Add Funds

setup-nav-perps.intent: Open the Perps tab (pushes a history entry)

setup-nav-market.intent: Open the BTC market detail screen (pushes a history entry)

setup-wait-market.intent: Wait for market detail before opening order entry

setup-nav-order.intent: Open the order entry screen (pushes a history entry on top of market detail)

ac1-wait-order-entry.intent: AC1: order entry screen is rendered with the Add Funds entry point

ac1-press-add-funds.intent: AC1/TAT-3272: tap the Available-to-trade Add Funds (+) icon

ac1-wait-deposit.intent: TAT-3272: the deposit confirmation opens (Arbitrum network added automatically). Before the fix this never appeared.

ac1-screenshot-deposit.note: TAT-3272: deposit confirmation screen opened after tapping Add Funds

ac1-press-deposit-back.intent: Return from the deposit screen to the order entry screen

ac1-wait-back-order-entry.intent: Back on the order entry screen after the deposit round-trip

ac1-press-order-back.intent: AC1/TAT-3131: tap the order-entry back button ONCE

ac1-wait-market-detail.intent: TAT-3131: a SINGLE back tap returns to the market detail screen (no phantom, no double-tap). Before the fix one tap landed on the phantom confirmation.

ac1-assert-market-detail-control.intent: Confirm a market-detail-specific control is present after the single back tap

ac1-screenshot-market-detail.note: TAT-3131: one tap of the order-entry back button (after visiting Add Funds) lands on the Perps market detail screen

must_show: perps market detail screen for BTC

ac1-screenshot-market-detail.intent: Capture market detail reached in a single back tap after the deposit round-trip

done.intent: Finish: Add Funds opens and one back tap returns to market detail
